      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Carries the Validation label and modifies block file storage error handling in src/flatfile.cpp to fix silent failure modes during ActivateBestChain block connection.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes a failure mode where block directory filesystem errors throw an unhandled exception during ActivateBestChain that gets swallowed by P2P logging, 'leaving the node looking healthy while the block processing mechanism is stuck'. Resolving silent chain freeze under storage errors is a substantial reliability improvement."
